edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of LP tokens.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
setFeeTo requires msg.sender == feeToSetter, caller-controlled authorization.
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender == feeToSetter, caller-controlled authorization.
initialize requires msg.sender == factory, so pair setup depends on caller identity.
Pair constructor assigns factory = msg.sender, an untrusted deployer address.
permit validates deadline >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
_update derives timeElapsed from block.timestamp for price accumulators.
permit reads and increments nonces[owner] to prevent signature replay.
permit embeds DOMAIN_SEPARATOR in the signed digest.
permit writes an allowance entry after signature verification.
permit derives the signer address via ecrecover from caller-supplied v, r, s.
transferFrom decrements the stored allowance.
transferFrom updates balanceOf through _transfer.
mint reads pool balances to compute liquidity.
burn reads LP balanceOf of the pair contract.
burn refreshes kLast when fees are enabled.
mint refreshes kLast when fees are enabled.
swap reads reserve0 for the liquidity and invariant checks.
swap reads reserve1 for the liquidity and invariant checks.
_update writes the new reserve0 value.
_update writes the new reserve1 value.
_update stores the current block timestamp in blockTimestampLast.
price0CumulativeLast += ... relies on intentional unchecked uint overflow.
price1CumulativeLast += ... relies on intentional unchecked uint overflow.
_safeTransfer performs the raw token.call low-level invocation.
swap optimistically transfers output tokens via _safeTransfer before reserves are updated.
burn performs external token transfers before refreshing reserves.
skim performs external token transfers while relying on the lock for safety.
swap calls the attacker-controlled uniswapV2Call hook when data length is non-zero.
The flash-swap callback can re-enter swap before reserves are synchronised; mitigated by the lock modifier.
createPair deploys the pair using inline assembly create2.
createPair records the new pair in getPair (both directions).
createPair pushes the new pair address into allPairs.
Only feeToSetter-gated callers can overwrite feeTo.
Only feeToSetter-gated callers can overwrite feeToSetter.
initialize writes token0 but is restricted by the factory check.
initialize writes token1 but is restricted by the factory check.
Pair constructor stores msg.sender as the trusted factory address.
Factory constructor initialises the privileged feeToSetter account.
_mint increases totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
_burn decreases totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
_mintFee reads feeTo from the factory to decide fee minting.
_mintFee resets kLast to zero when fees are disabled.
The lock modifier on swap uses the unlocked flag to block reentrancy.
mint is wrapped by the lock modifier.
burn is guarded by the lock modifier against reentrancy.
skim is guarded by the lock modifier.
sync is guarded by the lock modifier.
sync invokes _update with the live balances.
mint invokes _update after minting liquidity.
burn invokes _update after transferring tokens out.
swap invokes _update after the invariant check.
_approve writes the allowance mapping and emits Approval.
_transfer debits and credits balanceOf entries.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer after the allowance update.
approve delegates to _approve.
permit calls _approve after a successful signature check.
owner parameter flows into permit digest and approval.
spender parameter flows into permit digest and approval.
value parameter flows into permit digest and approval.
deadline parameter is checked against block.timestamp in permit.
swap recipient parameter flows into token transfers and callback.
amount0Out parameter drives the optimistic transfer and invariant math in swap.
amount1Out parameter drives the optimistic transfer and invariant math in swap.
data parameter decides whether the uniswapV2Call callback is invoked.
tokenA parameter is sorted and used for create2 salt and pair registration.
tokenB parameter is sorted and used for create2 salt and pair registration.
_feeTo parameter becomes the new feeTo value.
_token0 parameter is stored as token0 in initialize.
_token1 parameter is stored as token1 in initialize.
liquidity local is passed to _mint for the LP recipient.
_reserve0 local is populated from getReserves.
balance0 local is measured inside swap before and after the callback.
amount0In local is derived and used in the K invariant check.
feeOn local decides whether protocol fees are minted.
rootK local participates in the fee liquidity computation.
blockTimestamp local feeds the timeElapsed and accumulator math.

normalization_plan.reason: owner is only meaningful as the permit signer/approver argument.
spender is only meaningful inside permit's approval logic.
value is only consumed by the permit digest and approval.
deadline is only compared to block.timestamp inside permit.
to is the swap recipient and callback target.
amount0Out is used only in the swap transfer and invariant math.
amount1Out is used only in the swap transfer and invariant math.
data only gates the uniswapV2Call callback inside swap.
tokenA is only used to sort, salt and register the pair.
tokenB is only used to sort, salt and register the pair.
_feeTo is assigned to feeTo by setFeeTo only.
_token0 is stored as token0 by initialize only.
_token1 is stored as token1 by initialize only.
liquidity is consumed by _mint as the minted LP amount.
_reserve0 is a gas-saving snapshot returned by getReserves.
balance0 is measured and reused only within swap.
amount0In is derived and checked only within swap.
feeOn is the return value computed by _mintFee.
rootK is an intermediate value inside _mintFee.
blockTimestamp is the truncated timestamp computed and stored by _update.
